identity.short_identity: Full-stack AI product engineer and builder who ships end-to-end systems, from frontend polish to backend flows and LLM workflows.

summary.one_liner: AI product engineer with founding experience who has shipped real LLM systems in healthtech, marketing, and developer tools.
summary.short_bio: Ganesh Shinde is an AI product engineer based in Bengaluru, India, with founding startup experience at Bewell and production ownership at Black Duck. His strength is owning features end-to-end—from product thinking and AI system design to frontend Polish, backend flows, and deployment. He works primarily with React, Next.js, and TypeScript on the frontend, and has built multiple AI systems using Gemini, Vertex AI, prompt pipelines, structured JSON outputs, and document analysis workflows. He excels in startup environments, ships user-facing products, and contributes across product strategy, AI architecture, full-stack development, testing, and internal tooling.
summary.work_style: Execution-focused, product-minded, comfortable in messy startup environments, prefers high ownership and direct feedback over safe corporate paths.

family.notes: Father and one brother work in business; Ganesh chose an engineering and product-building path.

goals.primary_career_goal: Join a strong AI startup (preferably US-based or YC-backed) as an early / product engineer and build real AI systems end-to-end.
secondary_goals: Grow into a high-agency AI product / founding engineer.
Deepen backend, AI systems, and infra skills while keeping strong product and UX sense.
Avoid generic, low-ownership roles and optimize for learning, impact, and responsibility.
goals.long_term_direction: High-agency AI product engineering and startup building.

projects.name: HealthAI
projects.description: AI-powered health analysis platform that uses Vertex AI / Gemini to convert unstructured health data into structured insights and reports.
key_capabilities: Multi-format file upload (PDF, DOCX, Excel, CSV, TXT).
Biomarker analysis with clinical vs optimal ranges (50+ biomarkers).
Four pillars scoring (Eat, Sleep, Move, Recover).
Monthly health reports with trend analysis and radar-style visualizations.
Supplement recommendations and root-cause style health pattern analysis.
Interactive JSON outputs and prompt-testing interfaces for rapid iteration.
projects.why_it_matters: Shows ability to build a vertical AI product, handle unstructured health data, design multi-step prompt workflows, generate structured JSON, and ship a real deployed system.

projects.name: Stratifai
projects.description: AI SaaS platform that turns a product URL or description into a complete marketing strategy and content package in under 60 seconds.
key_capabilities: Dual input: URL scraping of product websites and raw text descriptions.
Three-step AI pipeline (product understanding, marketing strategy, content generation).
Generates ad copy, email sequences, landing page structure, CTAs and more.
Clean, section-based UI with light/dark mode and minimal, professional design.
One-click export to PDF, JSON, Markdown, CSV, social templates and 30‑day .ics content calendar.
No-auth, no-database architecture for fast deployment and simple scaling.
projects.why_it_matters: Shows applied AI product thinking for go-to-market workflows, combining scraping, structured prompting, exports, and a production-style SaaS UX.

projects.name: Napkiin (B2B Buyer–Seller Platform)
projects.description: B2B platform for buyers and sellers (e.g. alcohol brands and retail shops) that centralizes product ordering and communication, including orders placed by email.
tech_stack: Email integration (SMTP/API like SendGrid, Postmark, etc.)
key_capabilities: Separate onboarding flows for buyers and sellers.
Sellers can list products and get a landing page for their brand on the platform.
Buyers can browse sellers, place orders, and chat with sellers through the platform.
Each seller gets a unique platform email address (e.g. seller@platform.com) for order communication.
Emails sent to that address are ingested and surfaced as conversations/orders inside the platform.
Sellers can reply to those email-originated conversations from the in-app chat, and replies are delivered back to the buyer’s email.
All orders and conversations (in‑platform + email) are unified in one place for each seller.
projects.why_it_matters: Shows ability to design a real B2B workflow product that unifies multiple communication channels (in-app chat + email), models roles (buyer/seller), and builds something closer to a real business system instead of a toy app.
